name: uww-canvas-chatgpt
description: Connect ChatGPT desktop to UW-Whitewater Canvas with local token prompts and encrypted storage.

interface.shortDescription: Courses, due dates, grades, files, and discussions in ChatGPT.
interface.longDescription: Read your UW-Whitewater Canvas coursework with your own token. A local prompt saves the token with Windows DPAPI or macOS Keychain. Submissions and posts require on-screen confirmation.
defaultPrompt: What is due next in Canvas?
